title: The Efreet took one, then dealt three
era: 2015 Eternal Weekend Old School using modern triggers
story: My Serendib Efreet was ready at the beginning of my upkeep beside an untapped Island , with Swords to Plowshares in hand. Its triggered ability dealt one damage to me, dropping my life total from five to four. I drew, declared the flying 3/4 as an attacker, and my opponent had no creature with flying or reach to block it. The Efreet dealt three combat damage, moving my opponent from six to three life. I had traded one point of life for a three-point attack this turn. The odd green-framed Revised printing on another table did not change my original blue card's cost or color.
review: Efreet 3/4 with upkeep damage controller, 5->4. Flying unblocked 3 damage 6->3, creature began turn under controller. Revised misprint historically blue card with wrong green border/Ifh-Biff image.
claim: representative reconstruction; not a historical match or quotation
